# presentame.

> Professional, SEO-optimised websites for small businesses — from just £50.

presentame. is a UK-based web design and development service specialising in beautiful, fast, and SEO-ready websites for small businesses. Every site is built with clean code, optimised for search engines and AI discovery, and includes a custom domain.

## Services

- **Simple Website** — A fully SEO and GEO optimised website, mobile-first, with custom domain included. One-time fee of £50.
- **Hosting & Maintenance** — Reliable hosting, content updates, performance monitoring, and security checks. £10/month, cancel any time.
- **Bespoke Build** — Fully custom web design and development for businesses with more complex requirements. E-commerce, booking systems, API integrations. Priced on enquiry.

## Contact

- Email: hello@presentame.online
- Website: https://presentame.online

## Notes

presentame. does not use page builders or templates. All sites are hand-coded for performance and long-term maintainability.
